payload.title: Rate-limit incoming webhooks per tenant
payload.goal: POST /webhooks answers 429 with a Retry-After header when one tenant sends more webhooks than the configured limit in the configured window. Put the limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts, wire it into src/routes/webhooks.ts (and src/app.ts if it needs shared state), and read the limit and the window through loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults. Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.
acceptance: A tenant over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
The limit and the window come from config, not constants in a route
The suite stays green with new tests for the 429 path

payload.text: All 31 tests and typecheck pass - now verifying the final diff before wrapping up.

Continued T-0001 from the handover packet.

What I did:
- Verified the 2 failing `test/config.test.ts` cases were stale expectations after the prior run added `rateLimitMax` / `rateLimitWindowMs` to `loadConfig()` in `src/config.ts` and created `src/lib/limiter.ts` (fixed-window `RateLimiter.check(key, limit, windowMs)`).
- Wired the limiter into shared state in `src/app.ts` (`Deps.limiter = new RateLimiter()` via `createDeps()`).
- Enforced per-tenant limiting in `src/routes/webhooks.ts`: after missing/unknown tenant checks, `deps.limiter.check(tenant, deps.config.rateLimitMax, deps.config.rateLimitWindowMs)`; on deny returns 429 `{ error: 'rate limit exceeded' }` with a `Retry-After` header in seconds.
- Updated `test/config.test.ts` expectations to include the new config keys and env vars.
- Added `test/rate-limit.test.ts` covering: 429 + `Retry-After` on excess, other tenants unaffected, limit read from config, and window reset in `RateLimiter`.
- Ran `bun run test` (31 passed across 7 files) and `bun run typecheck` (clean) locally; the daemon re-runs the suite itself.

decision: Per-tenant rate-limit state lives in Deps.limiter, a shared RateLimiter instance keyed by the X-Tenant header value.
decision: POST /webhooks checks the limiter after tenant validation but before body parsing, using deps.config.rateLimitMax and deps.config.rateLimitWindowMs, returning 429 with a Retry-After header when over the limit.
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because the prior run added rateLimitMax and rateLimitWindowMs to loadConfig() without updating the locked expectations.

What I did not finish:
- Nothing open for the acceptance criteria; all four points (429 + Retry-After, per-tenant isolation, config-driven, green suite with 429 tests) are implemented in the worktree.

What I did not look at:
- The mounted `review-voice-policy` skill (no `.review-voice/policy.yaml` work in this task).
- Performance/load behavior beyond the in-memory fixed-window limiter; no persistence or distributed limiting.
